description: Specify the porosity calculation mode. The centroid mode is the default mode.
notes: Live, 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 all accept only the bare keywords centroid and polyhedron; the quoted-string form documented in the 6.0 manual is rejected on every version.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): centroid and polyhedron accepted and the quoted-string form rejected on all three consoles.
